title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.155 QA: reworks the Character Sheet header and quick-stat area after visual QA. The sheet now uses a wider desktop-first window, a cleaner parchment quick-info band with separate Characteristics and Health & Defense groups, full labels instead of cramped mini boxes, improved header proportions, and better spacing across the three-column Summary layout. Preserves five-pip Skills, Talent Tier lanes, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
